verdict: Organic traffic is holding; paid campaigns are paused this period.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, all activity came from organic sources — no paid spend ran on Meta or Google Ads. Your Google Business Profile drove 55 actions (36 direction requests, 18 website clicks, 1 call), and your website received 188 sessions from 150 visitors. Conversion tracking is being reviewed, as zero conversions were recorded despite meaningful site traffic, which points to a tracking gap rather than a drop in real-world interest.
